title: Killer Alchemist -Assassinations in Another World-
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Late, an assassin with a 99.9% success rate, takes a job from a mysterious client who turns out to be Mises, a goddess from another world nearly destroyed after losing a war (Manga UP! blurb via AniList, MU, Penguin). Her mission for him is to assassinate Masra Dzur, another god of her world, in a game-like world where 'dying' has major consequences (Penguin). Adapted from a light novel; MU lists alchemy, crafting, royalty and bodyguard elements; ongoing.
life_message: Competence, planning and ruthless skill used on behalf of a patron goddess can remake a world.
